scope: Broaden the open-source DWG/DXF comparison by reconciling parser, payload-reader, geometry-kernel, projection, and native-consumer evidence dependencies; refine the existing 3D composed gate without adding per-slice validation cost.

method.kind: Primary-source documentation, release-note, and issue review with local implementation/test-plan reconciliation
localInspection: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing Slice8/PAR-06/PAR-07, S2/S3/S5/S8 and external-J evidence gates
tests/dwg_reader_matrix_tests.cpp: marker-payload AcDs record dispatch, physical/index order, and Blob01 page-chain controls
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: 7BA implementation ledger and 2026-10-17 stage/adopt rollback progress section
method.limitations: Sources disclose intended routes and known limits but do not qualify a particular local drawing or installed consumer. LibreDWG issue #1411 is scoped to the reported build and was not rerun. CADMPEG source-lineage independence was not audited. No external geometry was generated or decoded in this review.

evidence.topic: Outer DWG/AcDs versus bare ACIS evidence
evidence.observed: LibreDWG issue #1411 reports that an AC1032 REGION survives a conversion while its SAB body stored in AcDb:AcDsPrototype_1b is lost in the named 0.14.8593 build. CADMPEG v0.6.1 reads bare SAT/SAB rather than DWG/DXF/AcDs. Therefore a bare-payload parse cannot prove the DWG entity-to-data-storage association.
doesNotEstablish: the issue's behavior on current LibreDWG master or on libdxfrw
a complete AcDs index/owner join from source code presence or entity counts
evidence.planUse: Require a separately established per-handle entity→AcDs key/index→payload digest join; classify unresolved or order-only association as INCONCLUSIVE.

evidence.observed: ezdxf documents ACIS carrier browsing and limitations in rendering/general 3D. cq-acis supplies selected SAT/SAB-to-OpenCASCADE shapes, while FreeCAD is also OpenCASCADE-based and its DWG wrapper converts through an external converter to DXF before the selected DXF importer. These are distinct processing stages but not two independent kernel results.
doesNotEstablish: stock FreeCAD acceptance of ACIS/SAB as solids
general B-rep transfer by ezdxf or cq-acis
an independent geometry-kernel vote from FreeCAD when the same OCCT lineage is used
evidence.planUse: Record parser identity, kernel identity, FreeCAD converter/importer/backend, platform, options, and each result as separate evidence fields. Mark stock ACIS import not applicable absent an exact modeler-capable plugin.

evidence.topic: Fast local tests versus one composed valid-geometry checkpoint
evidence.observed: The local AcDs reader-matrix vectors cover framing, record order, owner association, and byte identity with marker payloads. They do not contain a valid SAB shape. Peer documentation supports using an ezdxf-authored scratch payload as a producer/carrier control but not as its own semantic oracle; CADMPEG is a candidate bare-stream cross-check with a declared L1 profile score.
doesNotEstablish: valid SAB semantics from marker-byte tests
semantic correctness from producer self-readback or CADMPEG L1
a need to execute external tools for each implementation slice
evidence.planUse: Keep focused generated fast tests per slice. At the existing composed checkpoint only, generate a temporary non-symmetric cube, use separately authored analytic expectations, pin/hash any optional tool, and record unavailable routes without blocking local implementation.

readinessRefinement: make outer-container association, bare-payload parsing, B-rep/kernel validation, explicit-geometry projection, and native consumer acceptance separate report layers
do not count FreeCAD and cq-acis as independent kernel votes when both use OpenCASCADE
require independent AcDs owner/index/payload association for any DWG solid claim; a payload reader cannot satisfy that layer
defer valid generated SAB and optional peer/kernel/native routes to one composed checkpoint, with no new per-slice runs
synchronize the 7BA ledger to reflect the already-passing synthetic rollback transcript while retaining actual-pipeline and allocator-accounting work as open
